description: 02/04/2026 The SIDBI family came together in Mumbai for a memorable Annual Staff Welfare Gathering, thoughtfully organised by the Local Welfare Committee. The evening brought colleagues and their families under one roof, creating a warm and vibrant atmosphere that celebrated the spirit of unity, togetherness, and camaraderie.
